label: Aerosol optical depth 550 nm, 1 km (MODIS MAIAC)
source: MODIS Terra+Aqua MAIAC MCD19A2 v061 via Google Earth Engine (MODIS/061/MCD19A2_GRANULES)
aggregation: per-pixel mean of best-quality, cloud-free daily retrievals in the month (0.01° grid), then mean of cells with a value inside the county
notes: Haze from dust and smoke, measured by the MODIS satellites at 1 km (about 50 times finer than the NASA POWER/MERRA-2 value). Only cloud-free, best-quality retrievals are used, so wet-season months (Jun-Sep) rest on few days and some cells have none; the county value is the mean of cells that have a value. Dry-season peaks (Dec-Mar) are mostly smoke from burning plus Saharan dust.
